parcels.where: state_class = 'A1' AND site_str_num > 0 AND bld_value > 0 AND (mail_state <> 'TX' OR SUBSTRING(mail_zip,1,5) <> site_zip OR mail_addr_1 NOT LIKE CAST(site_str_num AS VARCHAR(10)) || ' %')

signals.name: tax_suit

signals.where: CAUSENO IS NOT NULL AND CAUSENO <> '' AND TAXDEFSTRT IS NULL

signals.name: nuisance_case

signals.where: CASE_TYPE = 'Weeds/Trash/Stagnant Water on Property' AND STATE_CODE = 'Active'

ui.name: Houston
ui.title_cos: Stewart Title, Charter Title, Patten Title, all in Houston
ui.law: Texas lets you assign a purchase contract, but you must tell the seller and your buyer in writing that you are selling your contract interest, not the house (Occupations Code 1101.0045). Texas is a non-judicial foreclosure state: sales are the first Tuesday of the month and notices are posted with the County Clerk 21 days before.
ui.groups: "RICH Club (Realty Investment Club of Houston)", "Houston Real Estate Investors", "Houston Wholesale Deals"
ui.prefc: Tax lawsuit: the county tax office lists a court cause number on the account, so a suit to collect back taxes has been filed and a tax sale can follow. Dangerous building and code complaints are open City of Houston 311 cases at that address. A complaint is a report, not a finding, so drive by before you call.
ui.buyers_note: Companies that bought 2 or more houses in the last 18 months, most active first. Look up the owner on the Texas Comptroller search and call.
ui.buyers_empty: No buyers list for Houston yet. Texas does not publish sale prices, so the county data cannot tell a real purchase from a paper transfer.
ui.repairs: Repairs, Houston rough numbers per house: cosmetic 15-25k, kitchen+baths 30-50k, roof 10-18k, AC 7-12k, foundation 8-20k (clay soil, check every house), full gut 60-100k.
ui.sources: Harris Central Appraisal District parcel layer (owner, mailing address, market value), Harris County delinquent tax parcel list (April 2026), City of Houston 311 open code enforcement cases
